name: print-social-digital-marketing-sales-posts-yellow-and-white-greyscale-cutouts
title: Sales pack in white and yellow with greyscale women cut-outs and small geometric shapes
whatItIs: Nine square white posts with yellow serif headlines ('Digital Marketing With Ads Agency', 'Find Your Best Business'), greyscale cut-outs of smiling women, yellow half-circles, squares, plus signs and triangles, bullet lists and small yellow buttons.
whatItMeans: Bright and friendly; greyscale people with one warm yellow keep it clean and cohesive.
techniques: Keep photos greyscale with one warm accent.
Use tiny geometric confetti as decoration.
Pair a yellow serif with a black sans subhead.
